question: Does the managed Cloudflare verifier accept the documented Google-style dictionary form, and can a request-level result be paired with the exact proof?
scope: One controlled own-site identity, not Google/Exa impersonation, and no human-detection claim.

requiredEvidence.acceptance: An actual inbound request exposes a boolean request.cf.botManagement.signedAgent, with provider provenance. A category, generic verifiedBot, injected fixture or null is insufficient.

A controlled own-domain public key directory and accepted provider registration, with reviewed scope. Local key generation is not provider enrollment; no public enrollment or persistent credential operation is performed by saving this proposal.
Exactly one eligible paired Web Bot Auth candidate, one selected origin/key, clock and expiry recorded; raw signing bytes/headers remain private.
All controls excluded from public traffic, actual request/receipt/exact-row links match, optional raw capture remains off.

cases.managedExpected: measure after registration, do not infer from docs

cases.wireForm: g dictionary member, g signature label
cases.managedExpected: measure; this is the disputed advertised profile
record actual result; unexpected positive is an investigation, not a human false positive

cases.localCryptographicOracle: policy rejection using an unambiguously elapsed interval

cases.managedExpected: record baseline; a generic verified-bot result is not signature verification

cases.localCryptographicOracle: valid mathematical signature under controlled discoverable key
cases.managedExpected: tests registration/trust separately; preserve unavailable versus rejected

comparisonRules: Keep URL, source, declaration, covered components and key identity constant where the wire encoding permits; sign each encoding independently.
Use the controlled identity and truthful test UA; never claim a Google or Exa private key.
Capture true, false, unavailable and unrecognized native results separately.
One proof per request prevents first-valid signer-selection differences from masquerading as provider disagreement.
Do not override request.cf in production or count workerd fixtures as the managed service.
Nonce presence is not a uniqueness guarantee; repeat/expiry controls need a separate interpretation.
Native authentication error/abstention rates apply only to the labelled authentication cohort, not people or production prevalence.
A native boolean is a provider assertion, not proof of full draft conformance, exact covered components or human intent. Negative controls must test its interpretation.

proposedBounds.tails: exact trial/header/version filters; stop owned process after capture

execution: No production experiment, registration, rule, credential, permission or plan change is performed by saving this proposal.

denominators: valid local oracle and accepted identity prerequisites
measurementContract.nativeDisagreements: Report by condition and wire form; investigate registration, timing and field semantics before attributing a cryptographic failure.
